unit.why: A quotation from Yeven Metzulah describing the general customs of hospitality and charity in pre-1648 Poland (guests, poor students, dowering poor brides); it is a habitual description used as an ethical lesson, with no specific event happening to anyone.
unit.boundary_note: Part of the compiler's ongoing discussion of hospitality (הכנסת אורחים), which runs from the previous division into the next.
